product.title: Private tour for 12 people on a 40 ft Yacht, Ft Lauderdale bay

description.text: See Fort Lauderdale from the water with a private yacht charter on a 40-foot yacht for up to 12 passengers. BYOB, with an included cooler stocked with ice and bottled water. Equipment, safety briefings, and local commentary are handled so you can focus on Fort Lauderdale's waterways and coastal wildlife. Ideal for groups on Fort Lauderdale's Intracoastal Waterway who want a private captain without handling marina logistics.
